findings.evidence: template/scripts/finish_task.py:1049 calls sync_queue_merged_task. Lines 1060-1082 run queue_local_status and sync_merged_task again for the same merged state. The updated test side_effect=[waiting, waiting] / [None, None, waiting] shows the doubled read.
findings.summary: The merged queue state is observed and synchronized twice per finish. The new early helper and the existing queue block both call local_status and sync_merged_task. The design says only 'one extra PR read' and does not describe the second synchronization. It also leaves duplicate logic and error messages in finish_task.main.

findings.evidence: sync_queue_merged_task returns False when `not queue_enabled(work)`. The new spec says 'When the exact PR of the task branch is merged, finish SHALL run the post-merge reconcile path ... An unreadable PR state SHALL stop finish explicitly.' The proposal Impact lists '`lifecycle_preflight` board condition'. The diff leaves the preflight code unchanged.
findings.summary: The spec requires reconcile ahead of handoff whenever the exact PR of the task branch is merged. The implementation detects this only through publication_queue.enabled and local_status. The proposal also lists a lifecycle_preflight board-condition change in its Impact section, but the diff has no such change; the design instead relies on the preflight being skipped.
